description: EvalBench unified record schema — 5-track benchmark for handwritten educational document understanding

ground_truth.example: The mitochondria produces ATP via oxidative phosphorylation.

extra.description: Source-specific fields e.g. writer_id, question_id, per_question_scores

Track 1 — OCR.paper1_connection: Basic legibility — prerequisite for all downstream tasks

Track 2 — Document Understanding.task: Page structure parsing, answer localization, layout understanding
Track 2 — Document Understanding.paper1_connection: Models hallucinate structure — this tests whether they locate content correctly

Track 3 — Educational Assessment.task: Given handwritten answer image + rubric, assign score
Track 3 — Educational Assessment.paper1_connection: Core grading task — direct target of trustworthiness concerns

Track 4 — Multimodal Understanding.task: STEM diagram interpretation, visual reasoning, VQA over educational documents
Track 4 — Multimodal Understanding.paper1_connection: Multimodality criterion identified in Paper 1 as underserved

Track 5 — Trustworthiness.task: Evaluate confidence calibration, evidence grounding, explanation quality
Track 5 — Trustworthiness.paper1_connection: Direct operationalization of Paper 1 trustworthiness gap findings

splits.test: 20% within each dataset; small datasets (Mendeley, gopika13, IEEE) assigned entirely to test

reviewer_arguments.vs_IAM: IAM evaluates handwriting recognition only — no educational context, no grading, no trustworthiness
reviewer_arguments.vs_DocVQA: DocVQA contains invoices and forms — not handwritten exam scripts with grading context
reviewer_arguments.vs_Mendeley_alone: Mendeley has 50 scripts — too small for comprehensive multi-track evaluation
reviewer_arguments.vs_OCR_models: OCR is already solved for clean handwriting. EvalBench evaluates the full pipeline from reading to grading to explanation.
